Discrete Diffusion Language Models
Eve Green, Frank Black
NeurIPS 2025, 2025
Abstract: Masked discrete diffusion for language: corruption processes, sampling
schedules and the trade-off between parallel decoding and quality.
Discrete diffusion corrupts tokens with a masking process and learns to reverse it.
Parallel decoding reduces the number of sampling steps.
References
[1] Smith, A., Jones, B. (2026). Flow Matching for Language Generation. Journal of
